name: Attention Is All You Need
tagline: Eight authors casually end an era
flavorText: The most understated title in science. Everything you're holding descends from it.

name: AlphaGo Move 37
tagline: The move no human would play
flavorText: Lee Sedol left the room. The room never recovered.

name: The Board Weekend
tagline: Five days, three CEOs, one heart-emoji mutiny
flavorText: Fired Friday, reinstated Tuesday. The board 'lost confidence'; everyone else lost sleep.

name: DeepSeek Monday
flavorText: A hedge fund's side project made NASDAQ read a Chinese lab's paper.

name: The $7T Ask
tagline: Sam asks for more money than exists
flavorText: Not a typo. Roughly the GDP of Japan plus Germany, for chips.

name: Ghibli Day
tagline: The internet becomes a Miyazaki film
flavorText: GPUs melted. Miyazaki was not consulted.

name: The Pause Letter
flavorText: Six months to stop, signed by several people building faster.

name: The Transformer Eight
tagline: All eight authors, one stage, zero still at Google
flavorText: Jensen reunited the band. Every member had already gone solo.

name: Musk vs Altman
flavorText: Started a lab together to save humanity. Now suing each other over who is saving it wrong.

name: Google vs OpenAI
tagline: The empire vs the startup that read its paper
flavorText: Google wrote the transformer paper. OpenAI turned the thank-you note into a product.

name: LeCun vs Doomers
flavorText: Ask him about P(doom) and he will hand you P(you're wrong).

name: Open vs Closed
tagline: Weights want to be free. Or safe. Pick a side.
flavorText: The only war where one side publishes its ammunition.
